name: poster-hero
description: 海报式封面：超大标题居中 + 副行 + 底部域名（封面/开场两用）
css: #tpl-poster-hero { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); text-align: center; gap: 2.6vh; padding: 0 8vw; } .ph-t { font-size: 10vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .ph-s { font-size: 2.6vh; opacity: .72; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .ph-site { margin-top: 3vh; font-size: 1.9vh; opacity: .5; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .ph-t", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: "power3.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .ph-s", { opacity: 0, y: 24 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.45);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .ph-site", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, {start} + 0.9);
